# UX, Security, and Conformance Checklist: Agent Access Controls and MCP Release Gates

**Purpose**: Test whether Agent Access, secret handling, authority boundaries, and release evidence requirements are complete and reviewable
**Created**: 2026-09-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command for PR reviewers before implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are disabled, active, disconnected, stale-result, and operation-failure workspace states all specified? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK002 Are stdio, localhost HTTP, Observe, Operate, and Manage states each assigned truthful user-facing language and available actions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are every credential disclosure path and clipboard-failure disposition specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are client identity, lifecycle, evidence fields, retention, and clearing behavior defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005 through §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is one active named client distinguished clearly from future durable multi-client grants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is successful access evidence defined precisely enough to exclude preflights, rejected requests, and request content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Are validation limits for client names objective and byte-based? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is the meaning of revoke distinct from rotate and from stdio configuration removal? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do desktop controls preserve S070 runtime-only listener and credential semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Do guidance requirements consistently distinguish inherited stdio IPC access from HTTP bearer authorization? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK011 Do conformance requirements preserve the S069 resource count, permission class, and zero-tool contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can listener visibility and revocation completion be measured without subjective UX language? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK013 Can credential non-disclosure and rollback be demonstrated for every desktop operation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK014 Can request-evidence inclusion and exclusion be measured across the complete authorization matrix? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Are protocol, resource, template, and tool counts exact and version-bounded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are daemon loss, reconnect, concurrent lifecycle, counter saturation, and no-activity states addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are clipboard failure after both enablement and rotation assigned a fail-closed recovery requirement? [Recovery, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK018 Are package paths with spaces and non-ASCII characters covered without narrowing supported platforms? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK019 Are hostile-content cases tied to invariant discovery and authority outcomes rather than content filtering claims? [Security, Spec §FR-016, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Are keyboard, assistive-technology, viewport, and zoom expectations measurable for the complete workspace? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-018, §SC-006]

## Dependencies and Boundaries

- [x] CHK021 Is formal release-candidate qualification clearly deferred to #190 while package-shaped command smoke remains in S071? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK022 Are remote MCP, persistence, multiple grants, mutation tools, and request-content collection explicitly excluded? [Boundary, Spec §FR-020]

## Notes

- All 22 requirements-quality checks passed at standard PR-review depth. The primary focus is UX truthfulness plus credential and authority safety, with conformance and packaging coverage as the secondary release focus.
